cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Zero Trust Architecture on Salesforce'. Subtitle in white: 'Identity signals, policy decisions, data controls, API guardrails, and Agentforce action boundaries'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Identity and Session Signals' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'SSO + MFA', 'Device Posture', 'Network Zone' as bright white pill badges with micro lock icons. MID LAYER 'Policy Enforcement' vivid purple border — modules 'Transaction Security', 'Apex Guard', 'Connected App Policy' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Data and Action Controls' vivid teal/green border — modules 'WITH USER_MODE', 'Restriction Rules', 'Agentforce Actions' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Policy Decision Point' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'MuleSoft API Gateway' and 'Salesforce MCP Tools'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Request' → 'Verify Context' → 'Authorize Action' → 'Audit Decision' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Permission Sets Are Not Runtime Authorization'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Permission Sets Are Not Runtime Authorization'. Subtitle 'Static entitlement must be paired with request-time policy checks'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Identity Signal with lock icon', 'Record Sensitivity with database icon', 'Channel Risk with API plug icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'STATIC ONLY' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'ZERO TRUST GUARD' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: '@AuraEnabled public static Account getAccount(Id accountId) { return [SELECT Id, Name, AnnualRevenue FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId LIMIT 1]; }', right column green border '// GOOD' code: '@AuraEnabled public static Account getAccount(Id accountId) { ZeroTrustGuard.assertCanView(accountId, \"Account.Read.Sensitive\"); return [SELECT Id, Name, AnnualRevenue FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId WITH USER_MODE LIMIT 1]; }'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Baseline entitlement', 'Context policy', 'User-mode data access'. Footer bar: 'Zero trust = verify every sensitive request'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Agentforce Actions Need Hard Authorization'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Agentforce Actions Need Hard Authorization'. Subtitle 'Do not rely on prompt instructions for privileged Salesforce actions'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Agent Identity with robot shield icon', 'Action Scope with checklist icon', 'Audit Trail with event stream icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'PROMPT-ONLY CONTROL' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'POLICY-GUARDED ACTION' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'instruction: Only refund eligible customers\\naction: issueRefund(orderId, amount)', right column green border '// GOOD' code: '@InvocableMethod public static void issueRefund(List<RefundRequest> requests) { RefundPolicyGuard.assertAllowed(requests); RefundService.createRefunds(requests); }'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Action allowlist', 'Apex guard', 'Decision log'. Footer bar: 'Agents can request actions; policy decides execution'.
